title: Rangor
introBefore: Your PR passed review — and still contradicts a decision from three weeks ago. Rangor guards every linked PR and hands your agent a ready brief from Jira, Confluence, and Slack. Product:
features: Catch expensive mistakes before merge: a GitHub Check Run when a PR breaks an agreed decision.
Your agent stops working blind: one briefing — facts, risks, and what changed — instead of five-tab hunting.
Same package in Cursor, Sidebar, ChatGPT, and Claude: gather context once, use it everywhere.
Hours back on every ticket: ranked must-know with provenance instead of copy-paste archaeology.
Conflicts stay visible: see what’s still disputed — and what’s already decided.
Gets smarter from real work: usage receipts boost what your team actually cites, not search noise.
footer: Rangor · fewer blind agents, fewer merge surprises
